## Here is our preliminary data cleaning

```{r}
# Read the file and assign it to a variable
my_data <- read.csv("../data/cleaned_batting_stats.csv")

# View the first few rows
head(my_data)

```

Here is how many data points we are missing

```{r}
colSums(is.na(my_data))
```

```{r}
# Drop useless columns
my_data <- my_data[, !(names(my_data) %in% c("Rk", "Team", "Lg", "SB", "CS", "OPS.", "rOBA", "Rbat.", "TB", "Pos", "Awards", "Year", "RowNum", "IBB"))]

```

Summary again

```{r}
summary(my_data)
```
Fit linear model
```{r}
fit <- lm(RBI ~ . - Player, data = my_data)
summary(fit)
```
```{r}
plot(fitted(fit), my_data$RBI,
     xlab = "Fitted RBI", ylab = "Actual RBI",
     main = "Actual vs. Fitted RBI",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3))
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)   # perfect-prediction line
```

```{r}
vars <- setdiff(names(my_data), "Player")

pairs(my_data[, vars],
      pch = 16, cex = 0.2, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.15),)
```
